title: McLaren P1 at a Mountain Overlook at Sunset
label: PARKED & PEACEFUL
description:
Parked & Peaceful: a giallo yellow McLaren P1 at a mountain overlook at sunset, a soft wind at a mountain overlook as the sun goes down. 4 hours of slow, original lo-fi with the weather soft underneath, for working, studying, relaxing or drifting off to sleep.

No talking. No lyrics. No sudden sounds. Every track is original to this channel.
